resources.string: Your habits, one commit at a time.
A repo is a habit you choose. A commit records progress toward its target, including partial progress.
Start with an empty workspace on this device. No account or connection is needed. Your optional profile and preferences live in Settings.
Your workspace has no habits or commits. Create a repo to start recording your own progress.

GitHabit keeps your workspace on this device, without accounts or cloud sync. Uninstalling erases local data. Exports are plaintext and a chosen document provider may sync them independently. Restore validates a selected export and replaces, rather than merges, your workspace after confirmation.
A name and note for this device only. Leave either blank or clear them at any time.
Changes save when selected. System follows the device appearance.
Active weekly bridge: %1$s–%2$s (inclusive). These dates are fixed.

Save to change the calendar. Existing and current periods stay intact. Short bridges are unscored for weekly quotas; daily and selected-weekday habits continue normally. Stored progress never moves to a different date.
This workspace has no dated history. Saving applies the choice immediately.
Saving cancels only the pending request. Effective history and any active bridge stay fixed.
Check the device date before changing the calendar.
The local date is now %1$s. Review the projected dates, then save again.
Save habits and history as plaintext JSON.
Try another filter, or start a new intention.
Open a repo from the list to inspect its progress and history.
Name your habit, enter a daily target and unit, then choose when to reach it.
Reach the daily target on every active day.
Choose at least one weekday. Other days remain optional.

resources.string: The daily target and unit above apply to each qualifying day. Multiple commits on one date count as one day, not extra days or a total weekly quantity.

This habit change applies on the date shown, not next week. The resulting partial week is transitional and unscored, not a success or failure. All progress and earlier expectations stay intact. Settings → Week starts on is separate and takes effect at a future boundary.

resources.string: Archive without removing any commits. You can resume at any time.
Activity streaks count consecutive dates with any recorded progress, not schedule adherence. Future dates receive no early streak credit.
Newest recording timestamp first. Stored dates determine progress credit.
Recorded commit count is activity, not goal achievement. Partial and optional activity are included.
This period includes today or future dates. Unfinished obligations are pending, not missed.
No repos or assessed goals. Activity is zero.
Inspect a date for its actual amount, daily target, and schedule eligibility.
Intensity: 0, 1, 2, 3–4, or 5+ recorded commits per date. This is activity, not adherence.

Intensity: no progress, partial progress, or daily target reached (capped at 100%). Outlined cells are practice or not daily obligations. Weekly opportunity is not daily failure. Inspect a date for exact amounts and eligibility.
Each column is one resolved historical period. Bridges have fewer dates; blank positions are not missing days. Weekday rows follow the current preference without changing historical bounds.
Noninteractive recorded-activity chart, %1$s through %2$s. Intensity counts commits, not success. Use Explore by date for exact records.
Noninteractive daily-target-progress chart, %1$s through %2$s. Not schedule adherence. Use Explore by date for amounts, eligibility, qualifying dates, and weekly practice.
Choose a numeric daily target and a schedule: daily, selected weekdays, or a target-completed number of distinct days per calendar week.
Log any positive amount today. Complete remaining goal adds only the remainder of the daily target. Partial and optional activity stay recorded.

The overview heatmap counts recorded commits, not success. Per-repo heatmaps show numeric daily target progress. Explore by date gives exact amounts, eligibility, and weekly results without tiny chart taps. Day and week adherence have separate denominators; practice and pending periods are excluded.

Correct or delete existing commits, with Undo. Habit target, schedule, and status changes apply today; earlier expectations remain. Week starts on changes are future-effective and preserve old bounds, with short unscored weekly bridges. Activity streaks are not schedule adherence.
Daily target reached: completed practice date in an unscored period, not quota achievement.

Restore replaces the entire workspace; it does not merge records. The validated snapshot shown here is used even if the source document later changes. Routes, drafts and Undo are cleared only after verified replacement.
